'''April 2001 Minneapolis tournament (24 April)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota on 24 April 2001. [[Garrett Larson]] won it. It is known from Garrett Larson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2155">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-26-repost-mirkwood-deadbody-style-4-24-01d2155/ repost-mirkwood-deadbody-style-4-24-01], DeckTech (garrett "deadbody" larson, 26 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-26-repost-mirkwood-deadbody-style-4-24-01d2155/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Garrett Larson]]
